title: TraceEvent
description: One captured event in an Enhanced Agent Bus trace. Source of truth: packages/agent-bus-analyzer/src/agent_bus_analyzer/models.py (Pydantic v2).

event_id.description: UUIDv7. Unique per event across all traces.

recorded_at.description: Capture-side wall-clock; analyzer does not trust source clocks.

source_agent.description: Convention: <role>:<instance> (e.g., 'claude:worker-03'). Parses to role='unknown' if no colon.

target_handler_declared.description: Handler name from the bus payload — what the dispatcher tried to route to.

target_handler_resolved.description: Handler that actually responded; null on dispatch-failure / unwired-handler.

payload_ref.description: Opaque reference (hash or storage key). Bodies are NOT inlined to keep JSONL bounded.

kind.description: Three observable kinds. 'decision' originates from the gove-zone audit tail.

flagged_rule.description: Rule identifier that produced a policy-violation.

audit_receipt_hash.description: Reference to gove-zone audit chain when this event has a paired Receipt.

constitutional_hash.description: Active constitutional hash at capture time (16-char form). Repeated per event to detect mid-run rotation.

event_hash.description: SHA-256(canonical_json(event minus event_hash) + prev_hash) — full 64-char hex.

prev_hash.description: Predecessor event_hash in this trace, or null for the trace's first event.

then.description: ingest-gap events are intentionally NOT part of the prev_hash chain — they describe missing capture, so chaining them would falsify what was actually observed.
